description: India B2C Bus Wrap 2026. One row per logged-in user (rb_user_id) with more than 20 confirmed India bus trips in calendar year 2026 (IST). Confirmed booking = transaction.bus_ticket_events event_type=101, country_code=IND, operator_id not in (15926,19715). Future journeys included; cancelled bookings still counted as trips. Built by Athena aggregation then written to Iceberg and Postgres for GET /wrap/{rb_user_id}.

schema.name: rb_user_id
schema.description: Primary key. Logged-in redBus user id (rb_user_id > 0). One row per user.

schema.name: trips
schema.description: Count of confirmed India bus bookings (event_type=101) with journey date in 2026 IST. Cancelled tickets still count. Eligible users have trips > 20.

schema.name: seats_booked
schema.description: Sum of seats on those 2026 trips (COALESCE(seat_count,1)).

schema.name: trips_2025
schema.description: Same trip definition for journey dates in 2025 IST.

schema.name: trips_change_pct
schema.description: Percent change vs 2025: 100*(trips-trips_2025)/trips_2025; NULL if no 2025 trips.

schema.name: busiest_month
schema.description: Calendar month (1-12, IST) with the most 2026 trips.

schema.name: longest_gap_days
schema.description: Longest gap in days between consecutive distinct 2026 travel days.

schema.name: streak_days
schema.description: Longest run of consecutive calendar days with at least one trip.

schema.name: streak_weeks
schema.description: Longest run of consecutive weeks with at least one trip.

schema.name: streak_months
schema.description: Longest run of consecutive months with at least one trip.

schema.name: trips_percentile
schema.description: Percentile (0-100) of trip count within the eligible (>20 trips) cohort.

schema.name: first_trip_date
schema.description: Date of earliest 2026 journey (IST).

schema.name: first_trip_route
schema.description: Route of first 2026 trip: '{source} to {destination}'.

schema.name: last_trip_date
schema.description: Date of latest 2026 journey (IST), including future journeys.

schema.name: last_trip_route
schema.description: Route of last 2026 trip.

schema.name: total_km
schema.description: Total km travelled. Joins lis.distance_registry on city ids; missing routes use India average distance.

schema.name: earth_laps
schema.description: total_km / 40075 (Earth equatorial circumference).

schema.name: longest_trip_route
schema.description: Route of the longest single trip by km.

schema.name: longest_trip_km
schema.description: Km of the longest single trip.

schema.name: shortest_trip_route
schema.description: Route of the shortest single trip by km.

schema.name: shortest_trip_km
schema.description: Km of the shortest single trip.

schema.name: avg_trip_km
schema.description: Average km per 2026 trip.

schema.name: km_estimated_trips
schema.description: Number of trips that used average-distance fallback (no registry match).

schema.name: unique_cities
schema.description: Distinct origin/destination city ids visited in 2026.

schema.name: new_cities_vs_2025
schema.description: City ids visited in 2026 but not in 2025.

schema.name: top_destination
schema.description: Most visited destination city name.

schema.name: home_base
schema.description: Most frequent origin city name (inferred home).

schema.name: farthest_destination
schema.description: Destination of the longest trip (farthest by km).

schema.name: rarest_destination
schema.description: User destination with the fewest distinct travellers in 2026 India population.

schema.name: top_route
schema.description: Most travelled '{source} to {destination}' route.

schema.name: top_route_trips
schema.description: Trip count on top_route.

schema.name: top_3_routes
schema.description: Top 3 routes with counts, semicolon-separated.

schema.name: top_route_rank
schema.description: Rank among all 2026 travellers on top_route by trip count (1=most).

schema.name: top_route_src_lat
schema.description: Latitude of top_route origin (map trail).

schema.name: top_route_src_lon
schema.description: Longitude of top_route origin.

schema.name: top_route_dst_lat
schema.description: Latitude of top_route destination.

schema.name: top_route_dst_lon
schema.description: Longitude of top_route destination.

schema.name: fav_boarding_point_id
schema.description: Most used boarding_point_id.

schema.name: fav_dropping_point_id
schema.description: Most used dropping_point_id.

schema.name: night_trips_pct
schema.description: Share of trips boarding 21:00–04:59 IST (%).

schema.name: top_departure_hour
schema.description: Most common boarding hour 0–23 IST.

schema.name: fav_travel_day
schema.description: Most common weekday of boarding (e.g. Saturday).

schema.name: weekend_pct
schema.description: Share of trips boarding Sat/Sun (%).

schema.name: earliest_departure
schema.description: Earliest boarding clock time HH:mm IST.

schema.name: nights_on_bus
schema.description: Trips whose boarding + route duration crosses midnight IST.

schema.name: avg_lead_days
schema.description: Average days from booking (date_of_issue) to journey/boarding.

schema.name: closest_booking_minutes
schema.description: Shortest non-negative booking-to-boarding gap (minutes).

schema.name: usual_booking_hour
schema.description: Most common booking hour 0–23 IST.

schema.name: cancellations
schema.description: Count of 2026 tickets also present in bus_cancellation_events (event_type=201).

schema.name: app_pct
schema.description: Share of trips where sales_channel contains 'app' (%).

schema.name: top_seat
schema.description: Most booked seat label (first seat on multi-seat tickets).

schema.name: sleeper_pct
schema.description: Share of sleeper trips (%).

schema.name: ac_pct
schema.description: Share of AC trips (%).

schema.name: fav_operator
schema.description: Most used operator name (service_provider_name).

schema.name: fav_bus_type
schema.description: Most used '{AC|Non-AC} {Sleeper|Seater}' label.

schema.name: total_saved_inr
schema.description: Sum of discount amounts across 2026 trips (INR).

schema.name: savings_equivalent_tickets
schema.description: total_saved_inr / average per-seat fare.

schema.name: best_deal_inr
schema.description: Largest single discount (INR).

schema.name: best_deal_route
schema.description: Route where best_deal_inr occurred.

schema.name: cheapest_ticket_inr
schema.description: Lowest positive per-seat fare (ticket_fare/seats).

schema.name: solo_pct
schema.description: Share of trips with exactly 1 seat (%).

schema.name: trips_since_2025
schema.description: trips + trips_2025.

schema.name: km_since_2025
schema.description: total_km + 2025 km.

schema.name: ratings_given
schema.description: 2026 trips with a matching ugc.ratings row on tin.

schema.name: co2_saved_kg
schema.description: total_km * 0.10 (kg CO2 vs driving).

schema.name: tree_equivalent
schema.description: co2_saved_kg / 21.

schema.name: archetype
schema.description: Persona: Night Owl | Last-Minute Dasher | Planner | Sleeper Loyalist | Weekend Wanderer | Steady Traveller.

schema.name: signature_trip
schema.description: Most common 'route | hour | seat type | operator'.

schema.name: weekly_heatmap
schema.description: JSON string of week_number → trip_count for 2026.
